   City Council Meeting Agenda
  Tuesday, September 3, 2019

   CALL TO ORDER
   PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE LED BY: Council Member Harrington
   ROLL CALL: Mayor Pu, Vice Mayor Menchaca, Council Members Costanzo,
  Harrington, Liao

 1. APPROVAL OF AGENDA ORDER

 2. PRESENTATIONS – None.

 3. PUBLIC COMMENT

  This is the time set aside for members of the public to address the City Council on
  items of interest that are not on the Agenda, but are within the subject matter
  jurisdiction of the San Gabriel City Council. Pursuant to the Brown Act, the City
  Council cannot answer any questions or take any action until such time as the
  matter may appear as an item on a future agenda.

  In an effort to provide everyone with an opportunity to speak tonight, please be
  aware that all public comments will be limited to a maximum of three minutes. You
  will receive a 30-second warning as you approach the end of your time. As a
  reminder, please be respectful of all speakers regardless of the position they take
  on any items.

  If you wish to address the City Council, please complete a speaker’s request card
  and hand it to the clerk before the start of the meeting. When speaking, please
  state your NAME for the record.

 4. CONSENT CALENDAR

  All items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and
  recommendations will be approved in one motion unless a member of the
  City Council or audience requests separate discussion.

  A. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  The minutes are a record of the official actions taken at the City Council
  meeting.

  1. Minutes of the City Council Special Meeting of August 20, 2019.
  2. Minutes of the City Council Regular Meeting of August 20, 2019.

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – September 3, 2019  2
   Recommended Action: Approval.

  B. MATERIAL DEMANDS

  This is the presentation of the “Register of Demands and Warrants” for the
  payment of City expenditures.

  Recommended Action: Approval.

  C. RESOLUTION NO. 19-38 FOR TEMPORARY STREET CLOSURE AT 864
  COMMERCIAL AVENUE BETWEEN GLADYS AVENUE AND THE RUBIO
  WASH ON SEPTEMBER 21, 2019

  The Public Works Department received a request from Ogopogo Brewing
  Company for a temporary street closure for a one-year anniversary event on
  Saturday, September 21, 2019 from 2:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. on Commercial
  Avenue between Gladys Avenue and the Rubio Wash. Resolution No. 19-38
  (attached) details the location, date and times for the closure, as well as the
  conditions that must be followed by the applicant. The Public Works
  Department, Fire Department and Police Department have reviewed and
  approved the request.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-38 authorizing
  closure of Commercial Avenue between Gladys Avenue and the Rubio Wash
  from 2:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. on Saturday, September 21, 2019.

  D. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 19-42 APPROVING THE FIRST
  EXTENSION TO THE EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT BETWEEN PAULA
  CHAMBERLAIN AND THE CITY OF SAN GABRIEL FOR INTERIM FINANCE
  DIRECTOR

  On March 4, 2019, the City appointed retired annuitant Paula Chamberlain as
  Interim Finance Director and approved a six-month employment agreement for
  her services. Immediately following Ms. Chamberlain’s appointment, the
  Human Resources Department opened a recruitment for a permanent Finance
  Director with the expectation of filling the position by September 3, 2019. Staff
  has determined that additional time will be needed to complete this
  recruitment and is requesting that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-42
  approving a four-month extension to Paula Chamberlain’s employment
  agreement as Interim Finance Director, which is set to expire on September 4,
  2019.

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – September 3, 2019  3
   Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-42 approving
  the First Extension to the Employment Agreement between Paula Chamberlain
  and the City of San Gabriel for Interim Finance Director.

  E. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 19-41 APPROVING A NEW LIMITED
  SERVICE/PART-TIME POSITION CLASSIFICATION SPECIFICATION AND
  PAY RANGE FOR MANAGEMENT SPECIALIST

  As part of the City’s duty to maintain an effective position classification
  specification schedule (position schedule), the Human Resources Department
  regularly reviews the position schedule and collaborates with City Departments
  to ensure position quality and effectiveness. The City Council is requested to
  consider approval of a new limited service/part-time position classification
  specification and pay range for Management Specialist. The Management
  Specialist position is designed for attracting and hiring highly-experienced
  management professionals with specialized skills on an as-needed, limited
  duration basis. If adopted, Resolution No. 19-41 will amend the City’s position
  classification specification and pay schedules to include the position of
  Management Specialist, effective September 4, 2019.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-41 approving
  a new limited service/part-time position classification specification and pay
  range for Management Specialist.

 5. PUBLIC HEARING

  A. ZONE TEXT AMENDMENT TO UPDATE THE SAN GABRIEL MUNICIPAL
  CODE RELATING TO ACCESSORY DWELLING UNITS (ZTA19-001)

  In 2016-2017, former Governor Brown signed multiple bills into effect that
  amended Government Code Section 65852.2 to facilitate the development of
  Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs). Local municipalities were given the option to
  either choose not to adopt an ordinance which would make them subject to
  the State’s standards, or adopt its own ADU Ordinance in order to tailor the
  requirements to the existing development patterns in their community. The City
  of San Gabriel chose the latter.

  On June 19, 2018, the City Council adopted Ordinance No. 644 regarding the
  development of Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs) with a vote of 5-0. Over the

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – September 3, 2019  4
   past year, Planning Division staff has seen a number of inquiries come in from
  the public regarding ADUs. This “clean up” Zone Text Amendment (ZTA) would
  delete references to previous accessory unit options, provide clarification to
  ADU development, and add a requirement for a covenant to be recorded with
  all future ADU applications.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council:
  1. Conduct the public hearing and discuss the proposed Ordinance;
  2. Motion to waive the full reading and introduce the attached Ordinance by
  title only. The City Clerk will read aloud the full title of the Ordinance.

 6. NEW BUSINESS

  A. STATE OF NEIGHBORHOOD IMPROVEMENT SERVICES

  Staff will provide an update regarding the City’s Neighborhood Improvement
  Services program in the community. Please note that there is no staff report
  associated with this item; a Powerpoint presentation will be shown during the
  meeting.

 7. PUBLIC COMMENT

 8. CITY MANAGER’S REPORT

 9. COUNCIL COMMENTS AND CONFERENCE/MEETING REPORTS

  Each Council Member may address the City Council and public on matters of
  general information and/or concern. This is also the time for Council Members to
  report on conferences and/or meetings they have attended.

 10. CLOSED SESSION – None.

 11. ADJOURNMENT

  The next Regular City Council meeting will be held on Tuesday, September 17, 2019
  at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chamber at City Hall, 425 South Mission Drive, San
  Gabriel, California. Information regarding matters to be considered at each
  meeting will be available on the Friday before the City Council Meeting on the
  City’s website at www.sangabrielcity.com.
